claim_scope: Source-derived release draft, not an App Store Connect submission. Select the profile matching the archived binary and deployed service; the absence of an account does not establish anonymous or unlinked collection.
configuration: Configuration dependent. SceneParserService.isRemoteOffloadConfigured reports whether a provider is actually wired. Release Camera visual inference is local; SceneRemoteServiceComposition can enable an authenticated remote Scene service from validated deployment configuration.

data_collection.question: What data does the app collect off the device?
data_collection.answer: configuration dependent; remote-enabled operation collects data
data_collection.off_device_processing: Spoken input uses SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest without requiresOnDeviceRecognition; Apple may process microphone audio remotely. Apple-only collection is not declared as developer collection. The transcript remains editable text and becomes Other User Content if submitted to the configured Scene service. Local recording and the local sound meter do not upload audio.
data_collection.conditional: The final archive endpoint configuration, App Attest state, hosting logs, provider retention and privacy manifest must be revisited before release. A generic no-data-collected answer is invalid when remote Scene requests are enabled.

remote_disabled.developer_collection: No developer collection demonstrated by the current local Camera/AR/Scene/media paths, provided no remote provider is wired and no additional telemetry is deployed.
remote_disabled.manifest: The current empty NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes list is bounded to this profile and is not evidence for a remotely configured binary.

categories.evidence: Scene text, selected object IDs, clarification answers and generated scene content are held in the job store and bound to the authenticated installation. Completion retention is not instantaneous discard.

App Attest key/enrollment identity and persisted counter authenticate the same installation across jobs; owner_key binds job records to that installation. This is a conservative device-identifier classification, not an IDFA claim.
Job creation and completion times, installation quota events and job state retain the history of requesting generation for app functionality and abuse prevention.

additional_deployment_inventory_required: Classify actual hosted diagnostic/error/performance logs if retained; the local server fixture does not prove production logging or reverse-proxy IP policy.
Provider retention, secondary uses, subprocessors, location and linkage need the actual account/model agreement. A local database purge does not establish provider deletion.
Update NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes for the selected remote-enabled release profile and validate the built privacy report; the current empty manifest does not satisfy this profile.

evidence: Jobs are bound to App Attest installation identity. No de-identification boundary that breaks this association before collection is implemented. No account does not mean no linkage.

used_in: RecordingArtifactStore.swift:1308 stat() and :1411-1412 lstat() in the recovery/ownership scan (Apple classifies the stat family as File timestamp APIs)
RecordingArtifactStore (volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsage) checks free space before writing a recording

evidence: S07 2026-09-13 correction, tightened by the tools owner after reading the call sites: the earlier claim that no file-timestamp API is used was wrong. The File timestamp basis is the stat()/lstat() family (RecordingArtifactStore.swift:1308, :1411-1412); DiskSpace is volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsage (RecordingArtifactStore.swift:285-299). FileManager.attributesOfItem is used for file SIZE only, so it is not cited as timestamp evidence.

tracking.question: Does the app track users?

apple_basis.interpretation: Apple separates on-device processing from collection retained beyond servicing a request. App-functionality collection still needs disclosure. Device association can make collected data linked even without an account. Apple-only processing is not developer collection. These rules are applied below to repository behavior; the category and linkage decisions are engineering inferences, pending the final deployed-service inventory.

retention.working_job_database: Verified local implementation removes raw request on terminal state, completed result after 14 minutes, and all unfinished job content at 23 hours 59 minutes from creation. Maintenance is bounded to 30-second intervals and runs at startup/access. Explicit owned DELETE purges completed content and retains the idempotency tombstone. These operational margins target the master 15-minute/24-hour limits while the service is running.
retention.job_metadata: Owner/idempotency/request hashes, IDs, fixed versions and timestamps expire 30 days from job creation.
retention.app_attest_security_state: Installation key, replay counter and revocation identity are retained separately without automatic expiry. An approved identity deletion/retirement policy is still required; blindly deleting these records would weaken replay protection.
excluded_from_local_proof: Cleanup while the service is offline
Provider budget and App Attest security state

evidence.result: 353 collected/executed tests across 29 module groups; zero skips/failures/errors; source unchanged; 10 real loopback HTTP checks.
evidence.snapshot_scope: New stopped-state snapshot v2 exports Scene metadata tombstones without inserting private content, including interrupted exports. Extracted-package smoke and independent snapshot verification passed. Prior backups remain unchanged; auth/spend databases, provider retention, host downtime and security identity lifecycle are not covered by Scene content purging.
